description_en: Registers a customer to be invited
description_zh: 此功能用来报备一个待邀请的客户
kebab_example: aliyun agency create-customer --customer-name DoorBell_Marketing --customer-trade 0205 --customer-source website --nation AR --api-version 2022-12-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCustomer

parameters.help_en:
The customer industry name.
Use the Customer Trade enumeration
parameters.help_zh:
客户行业名称
请使用Customer Trade枚举
parameters.name: customer_trade

parameters.help_en:
The customer sub-industry.
Use the Customer Sub Trade enumeration
parameters.help_zh:
客户子行业
请使用Customer Sub Trade枚举
parameters.name: customer_sub_trade

parameters.help_en:
The customer source.
Use the Customer Source enumeration
parameters.help_zh:
客户来源
请使用Customer Source枚举
parameters.name: customer_source

parameters.help_en: The region to which the customer belongs. Call ListCountries to obtain the list of available regions for the current UID
parameters.help_zh: 客户所属区域 请使用ListCountries获取当前UID可作业区域列表
parameters.name: nation

Code.description_en: The code that indicates whether the call is successful
Code.description_zh: 告知调用是否成功的代码

Data.description_en: Indicates whether the customer is created. If the value is true, the Message contains the CID
Data.description_zh: 告知是否成功创建客户，如果为true，则Message中为CID

Message.description_en: The same as the Code parameter

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud uses this ID for error tracking
RequestId.description_zh: request ID，阿里云会根据这个进行错误跟踪

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the current API call is successful. Valid values:
True
False

This does not indicate whether the subsequent business operation is successful
Success.description_zh: 候选值:True/False，代表了是否当前API调用本身是成功的。不代表后 续业务操作的成功
